mentions.name: Proflect
mentions.description: A personal and professional growth platform that connects goals, journaling, and feedback into one flow, enabling intentional growth through daily reflection, clear goal-setting, and structured input from trusted people instead of using scattered tools.
mentions.problem: Growth-related activities like goals, journaling, and feedback are typically scattered across different tools; Proflect combines them in one place to make growth more intentional.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Proflect — a personal and professional growth platform that connects goals, journaling, and feedback into one flow. To help you grow by reflection, not just action.

evidence.value: I'm working on Proflect — a personal and professional growth platform that connects goals, journaling, and feedback into one flow. To help you grow by reflection, not just action.
